data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate the superiority of retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg versus placebo in glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Additional Glycemic Control
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in additional measures of glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Weight Management
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in weight management

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Combined Glycemic Control and Weight Management
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in additional measures of glycemic control and weight management

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Lipid Parameters (9 mg and 12 mg)
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 9 mg and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in measures of lipid parameters

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Blood Pressure (9 mg and 12 mg)
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 9 mg and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in measures of blood pressure

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Daily Average SMBG
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on additional measures of glycemic control

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Additional Weight Management
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on additional measures of weight management

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Diastolic Blood Pressure
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on additional measures of blood pressure

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Systolic Blood Pressure (4 mg)
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg with placebo on additional measures of blood pressure

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Lipid Parameters (All Doses)
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on measures of lipid parameters

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Lipid Parameters (4 mg)
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg with placebo on measures of lipid parameters

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Biomarker of Inflammation
data.text: To compare retatrutide 9 mg and 12 mg with placebo on biomarker of inflammation

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Patient-Reported Outcomes
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on patient-reported outcomes

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - PK/PD
data.text: To characterize the PK and PD of retatrutide and the relationships between retatrutide exposure and safety, tolerability, and efficacy measures

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Safety
data.text: To describe the safety of retatrutide in participants with T2D

data.name: Primary Treatment Regimen Estimand - HbA1c Change from Baseline (Retatrutide 4 mg vs Placebo)
data.populationSummary: Adult patients with Type 2 Diabetes and inadequate glycemic control with diet and exercise alone, naive to insulin therapy (except gestational diabetes or ≤14 days acute use), and not treated with any oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications within 90 days prior to study entry, with HbA1c ≥7.0% to ≤9.5% at screening (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population) Summary measure: Difference in least squares means of change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 40.
